prayerExcerpt.en-US: You are Peter, and upon this rock I will build my Church.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Tu és Pedro, e sobre esta pedra construirei a minha Igreja.

meta.face: Peter as on the peter card: an elderly man around sixty-five with a broad, weathered fisherman's face, a strong wide nose, deep-set earnest eyes and a lined forehead; curly grey-white hair balding from the back of the head with a curly tuft left at the forehead; a short, square, curly grey-white beard; a steady, teaching gaze straight out at the viewer.
meta.basis: Peter keeps the face of the existing peter card, the Byzantine type (short curly grey hair and beard, the forelock). The feast honours his office as teacher; the chair with ivory panels and Bernini's glory in the apse of St. Peter's are its real emblem in Rome.
